title: Evaluation after hardwiring left inputs
statement: Let $C$ be a directed acyclic circuit with $m+n$ input bits, fix an assignment $y$ to its first $m$ inputs, and let $x$ assign Boolean values to the remaining $n$ inputs. The evaluation of the circuit obtained by hardwiring the first inputs to $y$ at $x$ equals the evaluation of $C$ at the concatenated assignment $(y,x)$.
hypotheses_covered: $y$ assigns Boolean values to the first $m$ inputs
$x$ assigns Boolean values to the remaining $n$ inputs
